mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) is always active and predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in <= 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
